Cc=1pF and gm1≈230uS give GBW≈35MHz. gm7≈1.4mS puts p2 well above GBW, and Rz cancels the RHP zero, so PM ≥70°. Current budget: 10uA ref + 30uA tail + 110uA second stage ≈ 150uA, about 270uW. Long-L loads and a long-L tail give the gain and CMRR. Input gm/Id 18 leaves enough tail headroom at VCM=0.9V."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18, 12, 22),
    "L1":    (0.8, 0.3, 2.0),
    "Itail": (30e-6, 16e-6, 50e-6),
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmidp": (10, 7, 13),
    "I7":    (110e-6, 60e-6, 125e-6),
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Cc":    (1.0e-12, 0.5e-12, 2.0e-12),
    "kRz":   (1.2, 0.6, 2.5),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6); vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    I1 = It / 2
    gmidn = 12.0
    # bias / sinks (same gm/Id, L -> exact current ratios)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], It, vds=0.25)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)
    # input pair
    vs = vcm - 0.7
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.7 - vs, vsb=max(vs, 0.0))
    # PMOS mirror load and CS 2nd stage, same gm/Id and L -> zero systematic offset
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=1.1)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["kRz"] * (Cc + cl) / (m7.gm * Cc)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # vinp drives the side whose drain goes to the 2nd-stage gate (PMOS CS inverts -> non-inverting overall)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.R("Rz", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("Cc", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # predictions
    gm1, gm7 = m1.gm, m7.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = gm7 * Cc / (C1 * cl + Cc * (C1 + cl)) / (2 * PI)
    pm_mirror = math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg)))))
    wz = 1.0 / (Cc * (1.0 / gm7 - Rz))
    zph = math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw * 2 * PI / abs(wz))) * (1 if wz < 0 else -1)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - pm_mirror + zph
    cmrr = db(2 * gm1 * m3.gm / (m5.gds * (m1.gds + m3.gds)) / 2) + 0.0
    psrr = db(A1 * A2) - 3
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I7)
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 2.0 / slew * 0.5 + 4.6 * tau * 1.3
    noise = 2 * math.sqrt(4 * 1.38e-23 * 300 * (2 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)) * 8
    swing = 1.8 - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.1
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "cmrr_db": cmrr, "psrr_db": psrr, "slew": slew, "settle": settle,
               "noise_1k": noise, "swing": swing}
```
